about: Uploaded document text after the orchestrator's guardrail. Instruction-like parts are redacted and the rest is wrapped in untrusted-content markers. Only screened_text_for_prompt should ever reach the model; original_text is shown here only for comparison. is_suspicious, categories and detections are what the orchestrator records in result.security_flags.
in_the_app: compile_all_findings(result): result.screened_documents will hold the list of screened_text_for_prompt strings (empty when no document text was uploaded; being added on the orchestrator side), and result.security_flags lists the detections.
